$comment: Reviewed npm audit exceptions. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; scripts/audit-check.mjs fails CI once an entry expires or stops matching anything. See docs/SECURITY.md.

advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS when expanding deeply nested brace patterns. The only input is Tailwind's own `content` globs from tailwind.config.js, written by us and evaluated at build time; no user-supplied pattern ever reaches braces, and nothing from this chain ships in the bundle. No patched braces release exists; the fix is migrating to Tailwind CSS 4, tracked as a follow-up because it changes the CSS toolchain and minimum browser support.
